intro: I'm Sachin Raj. I build robotic systems and figure out how to make them reliable.

My background is in mechanical engineering, but my career took me into clinical genomics, where I validated systems that processed data produced by next-generation sequencing (NGS). In that environment, getting a system to run wasn't enough. We had to prove that it produced the right results, consistently and reproducibly.
I'm now building on that foundation with physical systems: robotics, hydraulics, sensors, controls, and the software that connects them.
The goal is simple: make sure the systems I build are governed, reliable, and work as intended.

contact.note: Open to research collaboration, technical questions about the tools or papers, and conversations with engineers working on robotic systems and validation methodology.
